_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

BEAR.desc: EPS -46.3%/yr (worst year FY09-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +14.1%/yr (Q4 sales ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY15 ex-FY17 median

BULL.desc: EPS +14.1%/yr (FY09-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +48.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY09-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2019-03-29) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.36x (70.7% downside to Bear $14 / +197.6% upside to Bull $142) | Adj composite 3.50 vs market 1.48: gap +2.02 [UNDERVALUED] | -22% above the EPP floor $61 (16x FY19E $3.80) | Conservative 2-yr case: +117.4% total (+58.7%/yr) | At 12.6x FY19E the 15% hurdle price $63 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. revenues +15.6% in Q4 2018, forward revenues +12% (no FY19 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2018 net sales growth ex-FX); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
